svg.title: J1-J2 square: the published energies at each size
svg.text: J1-J2 square: the published energies at each size
One panel per Hamiltonian, at every size with a published energy. Colour is the kind of number; filled marks can hold a record,
hollow ones cannot; the line joins the record at each size.
Energies per site as the table quotes them (the impurity problems in total energy), on each panel's own linear scale. Flagged rows, rows without
a declared kind and exact diagonalizations of a single symmetry sector are not drawn.
